task.title: Task 1: if-else Conditionals
task.description: Learn if-else conditional statements, output pass or fail based on score

c_stage.title: Determine Grade (Nested if)
c_stage.blocks_xml:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="variables_set">
    <field name="VAR">score</field>
    <value name="VALUE">
      <block type="math_number">
        <field name="NUM">85</field>
      </block>
    </value>
    <next>
      <block type="controls_if">
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="logic_compare">
            <field name="OP">GTE</field>
            <value name="A">
              <block type="variables_get">
                <field name="VAR">score</field>
              </block>
            </value>
            <value name="B">
              <block type="math_number">
                <field name="NUM">90</field>
              </block>
            </value>
          </block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
          <block type="text_print">
            <value name="TEXT">
              <block type="text">
                <field name="TEXT">Excellent</field>
              </block>
            </value>
          </block>
        </statement>
        <statement name="ELSE">
          <block type="controls_if">
            <value name="IF0">
              <block type="logic_compare">
                <field name="OP">GTE</field>
                <value name="A">
                  <block type="variables_get">
                    <field name="VAR">score</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
                <value name="B">
                  <block type="math_number">
                    <field name="NUM">60</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
            </value>
            <statement name="DO0">
              <block type="text_print">
                <value name="TEXT">
                  <block type="text">
                    <field name="TEXT">Pass</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
            </statement>
            <statement name="ELSE">
              <block type="text_print">
                <value name="TEXT">
                  <block type="text">
                    <field name="TEXT">Fail</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
            </statement>
          </block>
        </statement>
      </block>
    </next>
  </block>
</xml>
c_stage.description: Determine grade: >=90 is Excellent, >=60 is Pass, otherwise Fail. Note the nested if: first check >=90, then check >=60.

summary_points: if-else is used for conditional branching
Comparison operators return True or False
question_prompts: What would be output if the score is exactly 60?
What would happen if we changed >= to >?

blocks.explanation: 创建一个变量score，把85存进去。
if 后面跟条件，条件成立执行 if 里的代码。注意冒号和缩进。
>= 表示大于或等于。比较结果要么 True 要么 False。
print() 把内容显示到屏幕上。
